manifesto.heading: EVERYDAY UTILITY. ELEVATED EASE.
manifesto.body: Founded in Los Angeles, Pistola designs with utilitarian sensibility for the woman who demands her clothing work as hard as she does. Premium construction, impeccable fits, timeless silhouettes.

all-denim.description: Discover our signature denim collection designed in Los Angeles. From our cult-favorite barrel jeans to modern straight legs, wide flares, and timeless cuts crafted with luxury construction and utilitarian sensibility.

wes-high-rise-barrel-moonbeam.title: Wes High Rise Barrel - Moonbeam
wes-high-rise-barrel-moonbeam.description: Wes redefines the barrel jean with a high rise and full-length 30" inseam that delivers a clean, elongated line. With an allover rhinestone appliqué, the Moonbeam finish brings an eye-catching shine to a relaxed silhouette.
wes-high-rise-barrel-moonbeam.sizeAndFit:
• Rise: 12 1/4"
• Inseam: 30"
• Leg Opening: 16 1/2"
• Model is 5'9" and wearing a size 26.
• 100% Cotton
wes-high-rise-barrel-moonbeam.care: • Turn garment inside out, place in a garment bag, and machine wash cold on a gentle cycle to protect rhinestone embellishments. Lay flat to dry.

sloane-slouchy-denim-trench.title: Sloane Slouchy Denim Trench - Vintage Indigo
sloane-slouchy-denim-trench.description: Crafted from non-stretch premium cotton denim with a gentle garment wash, the Sloane Trench offers a relaxed silhouette with dropped shoulders, storm flap, and a detachable tie belt.
sloane-slouchy-denim-trench.sizeAndFit: Relaxed slouchy fit. For a tailored silhouette, size down one size. Model is 5'10 wearing size Small.
sloane-slouchy-denim-trench.care: Machine wash cold with like colors. Line dry inside out to preserve color richness.

rowan-relaxed-carpenter-pant.title: Rowan Relaxed Carpenter Pant - Utility Taupe
rowan-relaxed-carpenter-pant.description: Inspired by authentic workwear, the Rowan Carpenter Pant pairs a mid-to-high rise waist with a relaxed wide leg, functional hammer loop, and tool pockets in structured bull denim.
rowan-relaxed-carpenter-pant.sizeAndFit: Rise: 11.5", Inseam: 32", Leg Opening: 20". Fits true to size with relaxed ease through hip and thigh.
rowan-relaxed-carpenter-pant.care: Machine wash cold inside out. Tumble dry low or air dry.
details: Hammer loop and side tool pocket

aria-ribbed-cashmere-polo.title: Aria Ribbed Cashmere Polo - Oatmeal Heather
aria-ribbed-cashmere-polo.description: Ultra-soft knit polo spun from responsibly sourced Mongolian cashmere blended with ultrafine merino wool. Features a clean Johnny collar and wide rib texture.
aria-ribbed-cashmere-polo.sizeAndFit: Body-skimming fit with stretch. Fits true to size. Length: 22" from high point shoulder.
aria-ribbed-cashmere-polo.care: Hand wash cold in gentle wool detergent. Lay flat to dry on towel. Do not wring.

celeste-bias-cut-silk-slip-dress.title: Celeste Bias Cut Silk Slip Dress - Champagne Luster
celeste-bias-cut-silk-slip-dress.description: Pure silk charmeuse cut on the bias for fluid movement and an effortless drape that skims the curves. Finished with delicate adjustable French spaghetti straps and French seams.
celeste-bias-cut-silk-slip-dress.sizeAndFit: Bias cut allows gentle stretch and body skimming. Midi length hits mid-calf.
celeste-bias-cut-silk-slip-dress.care: Dry clean recommended or hand wash cold with silk wash.

devon-structured-boxy-denim-jacket.title: Devon Structured Boxy Denim Jacket - Raw Ecru
devon-structured-boxy-denim-jacket.description: Modern take on the vintage trucker jacket. Cut with a boxy, cropped silhouette, dropped shoulder, and oversized flap chest pockets in premium undyed ecru denim.
devon-structured-boxy-denim-jacket.sizeAndFit: Boxy cropped fit. Take your normal size for fashion-forward volume. Model is 5'9 wearing size Small.
devon-structured-boxy-denim-jacket.care: Machine wash cold inside out. Hang dry to maintain shape.

about.heading: Clothing for women going places.
paragraphs: Pistola is a Los Angeles-based womenswear brand founded in 2013 by Grace Na. With over twenty years of experience in the apparel industry, Na was able to identify whitespace in the denim market. She aimed to offer high-quality pieces with luxury construction and fabrication at a lower price than her counterparts. With her extensive knowledge of the industry, she made her vision a reality.

Over the last decade, the brand has naturally evolved into new categories, offering everyday premium pieces with street-smart and utilitarian sensibility. Two things have remained consistent since the brand's inception — quality and ease. Pistola continues to produce clothing for a busy, modern, and city-dwelling woman who demands her clothing work as hard as she does. Evolution is in our DNA, but our mission to bring women superior products at sensible prices will never change.
